subject.title: fix(media): support configurable containerWorkdir in sandbox media path normalization (#98446)

question: Should maintainers keep this conflicting branch as the final candidate for the OpenShell media-path fix, or route the canonical issue through a cleaner sibling candidate after proof?
rationale: Two external PRs target the same open canonical issue, this branch is not mergeable, and choosing the final branch/proof bar is a maintainer coordination decision rather than a deterministic code repair verdict.

options.title: Require one clean candidate
options.body: Land whichever candidate first rebases cleanly, removes unrelated scope, and has acceptable current-head media-path proof for the canonical issue.

options.title: Adopt this branch after cleanup
options.body: Ask this contributor to remove the doctor docs hunk, rebase, and add focused regression coverage if this branch remains the landing path.

options.title: Use the sibling branch
options.body: Keep this PR open for now, but close it later only if the sibling becomes the merged proof-positive fix.

recommendation.title: Require one clean candidate
recommendation.body: Land whichever candidate first rebases cleanly, removes unrelated scope, and has acceptable current-head media-path proof for the canonical issue.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced both the OpenShell backend and the original `/workspace` media mapping, making them the best available owner for branch selection and proof-sufficiency judgment.
